data.change_summary: Re-reverted the shrimp molt refactor that was re-introduced between the apply_fixes checkpoint (1bffa82) and the final_review checkpoint (f18ded0). Restored shrimp.rs, biology.rs, events.rs, snapshot.rs, and neocaridina_davidi.toml to the clean 929daa5 state and removed the out-of-scope molt_mineral_budget.rs test file. Applied the one in-scope pending amendment: extracted the hardcoded detritus consumption fraction `0.01` in estimate_substrate_microfauna_o2_demand_mg_per_s to a named constant MICROFAUNA_DETRITUS_DAILY_FRACTION with documentation explaining its provenance. The remaining four pending amendments all target the per-stage shrimp molt refactor which does not exist in the current codebase after revert and are therefore not applicable.
outstanding_risks: The shrimp molt refactor was re-introduced a second time by a checkpoint between apply_fixes (1bffa82) and final_review (f18ded0), likely from a concurrent project (tanksim-6e5.6.3). It has been reverted again. The per-stage molt system should be implemented as a separate bead with proper test isolation to prevent scope leakage.

Geometry scaling concentration parity tolerance remains at 0.55 for peak TAN and DO range. The substrate zone model introduces non-linear area scaling; this is a known modeling artifact, not a regression.
MICROFAUNA_DETRITUS_DAILY_FRACTION is a named constant rather than a ProcessParams field. If tuning is needed in the future, it can be promoted to ProcessParams at that time.
